symptoms.symptom: Incomplete cycle or timer not advancing

causes.label: Automatic load redistribution
remedies: Timer stops at 1 minute; machine has redistributed the load once or twice.
This is normal operation.
Do nothing; the machine will finish the wash cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Automatic load redistribution"

symptoms.symptom: Loud or unusual noise; vibration or shaking

causes.label: Cabinet moving
remedies: Washer is designed to move 1/4” to reduce forces transmitted to the floor.
This movement is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Cabinet moving"

causes.label: All rubber leveling legs are not firmly touching the floor
remedies: Push and pull on the back right and then back left of your washer to check if it is level.
If the washer is uneven, adjust the rubber leveling legs so they are all firmly touching the floor and locked in place.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "All rubber leveling legs are not firmly touching the floor"

causes.label: Unbalanced load
remedies: Pause unit, open door and manually redistribute load.
To check machine, run rinse and spin with no load.
If normal, unbalance was caused by load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Unbalanced load"

causes.label: Pump filter may be clogged
remedies: See the Care and Cleaning section on how to clean the Pump Filter.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Pump filter may be clogged"

symptoms.symptom: Snags, holes, tears, rips or excessive wear

causes.label: Pens, pencils, nails, screws or other objects left in pockets
remedies: Remove loose items from pockets.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Pens, pencils, nails, screws or other objects left in pockets"

causes.label: Pins, snaps, hooks, sharp buttons, belt buckles, zippers and sharp objects left in pockets
remedies: Fasten snaps, hooks, buttons and zippers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Pins, snaps, hooks, sharp buttons, belt buckles, zippers and sharp objects left in pockets"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: During spin the washer may need to rebalance the load sometimes to reduce vibrations.
When this happens, the estimated time is increased causing time left to increase or jump.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "This is normal"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Horizontal washers do not require the tub to fill with water like top-load washers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "This is normal"

symptoms.symptom: Washer pauses or has to be restarted, or washer door is locked and will not open

causes.label: Pump filter may be clogged
remedies: See the Care and Cleaning section on how to clean the Pump Filter.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Pump filter may be clogged"

symptoms.symptom: Door unlocks or press Start and machine doesn’t operate

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: Front-load washers start up differently than top-load washers, and it takes several seconds to check the system.
The door will lock and unlock.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "This is normal"

causes.label: Incorrect operation
remedies: Simply open and close the door firmly; then press Start.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Incorrect operation"

symptoms.symptom: Water does not enter washer or enters slowly

causes.label: Automatic self system checks
remedies: After Start is pressed, the washer does several system checks.
Water will flow several seconds after Start is pressed.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Automatic self system checks"

causes.label: Water valve screens are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and remove the water connection hoses from the upper back of the washer.
Use a brush or toothpick to clean the screens in the machine.
Reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Water valve screens are stopped up"

causes.label: Inlet hose screen washers are stopped up
remedies: Turn off the water source and remove the inlet hoses from the wall faucets.
Use a brush or toothpick to clean the screen washers in the end of the hoses.
Reconnect the hoses and turn the water back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Inlet hose screen washers are stopped up"

causes.label: Pump filter may be clogged
remedies: See the Care and Cleaning section on how to clean the Pump Filter.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Pump filter may be clogged"

causes.label: Fill hoses may be kinked
remedies: Check that fill hoses are not kinked or clogged.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Fill hoses may be kinked"

causes.label: Water supply is turned off
remedies: Turn on both hot and cold faucets fully.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Water supply is turned off"

causes.label: Energy efficiency
remedies: This is an energy-efficient washer.
As a result, the temperature settings for this washer may be different than for a non-energyefficient washer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Energy efficiency"

causes.label: Insufficient water supply
remedies: Make sure that the water supply is turned on.
Make sure that the water faucets are turned to their completely open position.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Insufficient water supply"

causes.label: The washer door is open
remedies: The washer door must be closed for all washer cycle operations.
If the door is opened during the washer operation, all functions will stop, including water filling.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "The washer door is open"

causes.label: Not enough detergent
remedies: Use correct amount of detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Not enough detergent"

causes.label: Not using HE (high efficiency) detergent
remedies: Use only HE detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Not using HE (high efficiency) detergent"

causes.label: Hard water
remedies: Use hottest water safe for fabric.
Use a water conditioner like Calgon brand or install a water softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Hard water"

causes.label: Water is not hot enough
remedies: Make sure water heater is delivering water at 120°–140°F (48°–60°C).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Water is not hot enough"

causes.label: Detergent is not dissolving
remedies: Try a liquid HE detergent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Detergent is not dissolving"

causes.label: Dye transfer
remedies: Sort clothes by color.
If fabric label states wash separately, unstable dyes may be indicated.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Dye transfer"

causes.label: Water supply is improperly connected
remedies: Make sure hoses are connected to correct faucets.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Water supply is improperly connected"

causes.label: Washer unused for a long time, not using recommended quality of HE detergent or used too much detergent
remedies: Run a Tub Clean cycle.
In case of strong odor, you may need to run the Tub Clean cycle more than once.
Use only the amount of detergent recommended on the detergent container.
Use only HE (high efficiency) detergent.
Always remove wet items from the washer promptly after machine stops running.
Leave the door slightly open for the water to air dry.
Close supervision is necessary if this appliance is used by or near children.
Do not allow children to play on or in this or any other appliance.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Washer unused for a long time, not using recommended quality of HE detergent or used too much detergent"

causes.label: Incorrect placement of detergent insert
remedies: Make sure detergent insert is properly located and fully seated.
Never put detergent above max line.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Incorrect placement of detergent insert"

causes.label: This is normal
remedies: It is normal operation to see detergent leak on door gasket about 20 seconds after filling the dispenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "This is normal"

causes.label: Dispenser clogged
remedies: Monthly clean the dispenser drawer to remove buildup of chemicals.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Dispenser clogged"

causes.label: Softener is filled above the max line
remedies: Make sure to have the correct amount of softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Softener is filled above the max line"

causes.label: Softener cap issue
remedies: Make sure softener cap for dispenser is seated or it will not work.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Softener cap issue"

causes.label: Laundry detergent packet placed in dispenser drawer
remedies: Laundry detergent packets should not be used in the dispenser.
They should only be added directly to the wash tub following the manufacturer's directions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Laundry detergent packet placed in dispenser drawer"

symptoms.symptom: Pump running while washer is not in use

causes.label: Clog in sump drain
remedies: This is normal.
Drain sump is detecting an undesired water fill level from a potential open faucet.
Shut off water valve and inspect water valve for blockage.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 22: "Clog in sump drain"
